detail: owner.lisp:~1892 wraps (fnn-developer-selector ...) and the fnn-err write in one handler-case serious-condition -> nil. fnn-developer-selector signals fnn-fault for an unregistered name (io.lisp:6958), so a typo'd literal silently disables the trace. Fix: keep only the fnn-err stderr write inside ignore-errors; let the selector read fault, or validate the literal against +fnn-developer-selectors+ at load time or in a test. owner.lisp is claimed by rl02, so not edited by lmg2.
source: deputy-C review of lmg2 diagnostic_sinks; key R7|fnn-owner-custody-trace|swallow:serious-condition:fault
title: fnn-owner-custody-trace swallows the selector read's fnn-fault
